_note: Existing branches use the feat/ prefix, so 'feat' stays a valid branch type alongside the standard set. Merge to main does NOT deploy.

G1.name: Code Standards
G1.desc: Pint formatting, Larastan static analysis, and the frontend build all clean. PASS = zero errors.

G2.name: Security
G2.desc: No OWASP Top 10 violations; input validated via FormRequests; authorization enforced on Livewire actions and routes; no mass-assignment of privileged attributes; no raw SQL without parameter binding.

G3.name: Alignment
G3.desc: Implementation matches the original request: complete, no scope creep, solves the stated problem.

G4.name: Test Coverage
G4.desc: Pest suite green with meaningful assertions. Fast sqlite suite runs locally on every change; the postgres parity suite must also pass before the work is called done (sqlite green alone is not a PASS for full/critical ceremony).

G5.name: Domain Correctness
G5.desc: Business rules produce correct results; role/tenant boundaries hold; edge cases tested; referential integrity maintained.

G6.name: DevOps Readiness
G6.desc: Migrations reversible (safe down()) and ordered; new env vars documented in .env.example; new config keys have sensible defaults. Both sqlite and postgres remain migratable.

G7.name: TDD Compliance
G7.desc: Red-Green-Refactor followed; no implementation committed without corresponding tests; tests assert behavior, not implementation details.
